scripts.collect: npx tsc -p ../shared/tsconfig.json && npm run build && node src/collect_data.ts
scripts.collect-moe: npx tsc -p ../shared/tsconfig.json && npm run build && node src/collect_moe_data.ts
scripts.record: npx tsc -p ../shared/tsconfig.json && npm run build && node src/record_replay.ts
scripts.replay: cd ../client && npm run build 2>/dev/null; cd ../trainer && node src/replay_picker.ts
scripts.test_replay: npm run build --workspace=packages/client 2>/dev/null; DATA_DIR=${DATA_DIR:-data} && case $DATA_DIR in /*) ;; *) DATA_DIR=$PWD/$DATA_DIR;; esac && export DATA_DIR && node src/test_replay_picker.ts
